text:
label: question
file: none

The symptom (Sydney user's Monday summary email arriving on Tuesday while London users receive theirs on time) suggests a timezone-handling issue in whatever job computes per-user send times for the weekly summary. However, repository search has not located that job: src/jobs/weeklySummary.js does not exist, and repeated searches for scheduling/email-timing code turned up no matches. The only file found, src/api/auth.ts, handles login and password reset and is unrelated to summary scheduling. Since no relevant source file has been identified, this cannot yet be filed as a bug against a specific location. Further investigation is needed to locate the scheduler/job responsible for computing send times per user time zone before this can be reclassified and assigned to a file.
